faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Podacium BI

questions.question: What types of data sources can I connect?
questions.answer: Podacium BI supports a wide range of data sources including CSV, Excel, JSON, and popular databases. We are continuously adding new connectors. Stay tuned for updates on additional integrations.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption (AES-256) for data at rest and in transit. All data is stored in secure, compliant data centers with regular security audits. You maintain full control and ownership of your data.

questions.question: Do I need technical skills to use Podacium BI?
questions.answer: No! Podacium BI is designed for both technical and non-technical users. Our AI-powered platform automatically generates insights and dashboards. However, advanced users can customize queries and create complex analytics.

questions.question: How accurate are the predictions?
questions.answer: Our models achieve 73% average accuracy across various prediction tasks. Accuracy improves over time as the system learns from your data patterns. We provide confidence scores with all predictions.

questions.question: Can I export my reports and dashboards?
questions.answer: Yes! You can export dashboards as PDF, PNG, or HTML. Data can be exported in CSV, Excel, or JSON formats. We are continuously adding more export options.

questions.question: What's included in the free tier?
questions.answer: The free tier includes up to 2 datasets, 4 dashboards, and basic analytics features. It's perfect for individuals getting started with BI.

questions.question: Can my team collaborate on the same dashboards?
questions.answer: Yes. Organization plans support team collaboration with shared datasets, dashboards, and reports. Team members can co-edit dashboards, leave comments, set permissions, and receive notifications when data is updated. Each organization has its own isolated workspace.

questions.question: Does Podacium BI offer an API for programmatic access?
questions.answer: Yes. Podacium BI provides a REST API that allows you to programmatically upload datasets, query data, generate reports, and integrate BI capabilities into your own applications. API access is available on Growth plans and above, with comprehensive documentation.

questions.question: How long is data retained?
questions.answer: Data retention depends on your plan. Free plans retain data for 90 days, Growth plans for 1 year, and Scale and Elite plans offer unlimited data retention with configurable archival policies. You can export your data at any time before it expires.

questions.question: Can I schedule automated report generation?
questions.answer: Yes. You can schedule reports to be generated daily, weekly, or monthly and automatically emailed to stakeholders. Scheduled reports support multiple formats including PDF, CSV, and Excel. This feature is available on Growth plans and above.
